name: fractal_breakout_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, 5-bar fractal swing highs — where one bar's high exceeds the 2 bars on each side over a 25-second window — represent micro price-discovery peaks where short-sellers and profit-takers cluster limit sell orders. When NIFTY's close breaks above a recent fractal high with all three Alligator SMAs (25s/40s/65s) in bullish alignment, it signals that resting supply at that swing level has been absorbed and fresh institutional momentum is sweeping the order book — stop-loss orders on short positions trigger a secondary push that typically extends 15-25 NIFTY spot points. We require 2 consecutive 5-second bars above the fractal level to eliminate single-tick noise disproportionately common in NIFTY's 5-second candles due to constituent rebalancing lag between the index and its 50 components.

indicators.name: fractal_up
indicators.formula: high[t-2] > high[t-4] AND high[t-2] > high[t-3] AND high[t-2] > high[t-1] AND high[t-2] > high[t], confirmed at bar t (middle bar is t-2)
indicators.purpose: 5-bar fractal keeps the exact same bar count as the original — 5 bars IS the mathematical definition of a Williams Fractal, not a scaling choice. At 5s resolution, 5 bars = 25 seconds, which is short enough to be a micro-swing relevant to our 15-120s hold and long enough to filter 1-bar index noise spikes. We track the most recent confirmed fractal level within 60 bars (5 minutes) as the current resistance level; older fractals lose relevance as price has already processed that information.

indicators.name: fractal_down
indicators.formula: low[t-2] < low[t-4] AND low[t-2] < low[t-3] AND low[t-2] < low[t-1] AND low[t-2] < low[t], confirmed at bar t
indicators.purpose: Mirror of fractal_up for swing lows (buy PE signal). Same 5-bar definition by mathematical necessity — the Williams Fractal pattern is not scalable; it requires exactly 2 bars on each side of the peak/trough bar.

indicators.name: alligator_lips
indicators.purpose: Fast Alligator line at 25s. Original used SMA(5) shifted 3 bars forward on 1-min bars. At 5s, we DROP the shift — Bill Williams used shifts for predictive charting purposes, but in a live trading system the shift introduces 15s of avoidable lag. SMA(5) at 25s is the fastest trend component; its crossing above SMA(8) marks trend initiation at our trading horizon.

indicators.name: alligator_teeth
indicators.purpose: Mid Alligator line at 40s. Original used SMA(8, shift 5) on 1-min. Compressed to 40s without shift because our 15-120s hold time requires the medium-term filter to span a comparable window — the medium Alligator line should be approximately 1/3 of the max hold duration. Preserves the 5/8/13 Fibonacci period structure of the original.

indicators.name: alligator_jaw
indicators.purpose: Slow Alligator line at 65s. Original used SMA(13, shift 8) on 1-min = 13-min context window. At 5s, 13 bars = 65s captures the current-bar directional bias. This is the CONTEXT filter — we only trade fractal breakouts in the direction the jaw is pointing. Choosing 13 (not 156 = 13×12) because we are detecting the intrabar trend regime for 15-120s holds, not the multi-hour trend.

indicators.name: session_vwap
indicators.formula: cumulative(close * volume) / cumulative(volume), reset at day boundary
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP as institutional flow anchor. Cumulative from open — no scaling needed. NIFTY breakouts above fractal highs that occur while price is above VWAP have higher continuation probability because every VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithm is already a net buyer — they welcome the breakout. Below-VWAP fractal breakouts fail more often as algos use rallies to sell.

conditions: close > last_fractal_up_level (fractal high breakout, within 60-bar freshness window)
previous bar also closed above that fractal level (2-bar persistence filter, eliminates single 5s spikes)
sma5 > sma8 > sma13 (Alligator in full bullish alignment — all three SMAs fanning upward)
close > session_vwap (above fair value — institutional net-buy regime)
VIX <= 24 (not in panic mode; above 24, fractal patterns degrade as NIFTY gaps dominate micro-structure)
buy_ce.confirmation: Two consecutive 5-second closes above the fractal level

conditions: close < last_fractal_down_level (fractal low breakdown, within 60-bar freshness window)
previous bar also closed below that fractal level (2-bar persistence filter)
sma5 < sma8 < sma13 (Alligator in full bearish alignment — all three SMAs fanning downward)
close < session_vwap (below fair value — institutional net-sell regime)
buy_pe.confirmation: Two consecutive 5-second closes below the fractal level

exit.stop_rationale: At delta ~0.5 for ATM NIFTY options, 4 option points corresponds to ~8 NIFTY spot points. A confirmed 2-bar fractal breakout that reverses by 8 spot points has definitively failed — the supply level held and new sellers are entering. This gives room for the 2-3 pt oscillation typical in a valid 30s breakout (30s NIFTY range: 2-5 option pts) while cutting losses quickly. 4 pts is tighter than deep reversion strategies (6 pts) because fractal breakouts are high-conviction directional events: if the book was really cleared, it should not come back.
exit.target_rationale: Fractal breakouts on NIFTY typically extend 15-25 spot points before the next opposing fractal forms, which at delta 0.5 yields 7-12 option points over 30-90 seconds. Targeting 6 pts captures the lower half of this expected range conservatively — achievable within 30-60 seconds on a clean breakout — giving 1:1.5 risk-reward. Setting target at the midpoint (not the upper bound) maximizes trade completion probability before the time stop fires.

filters.vix_filter: VIX <= 24 — above 24 NIFTY intraday gaps and whipsaws dominate over smooth micro-trend structure; fractal breakouts fail at high rates
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:20 IST — skip first 5 min (opening volatility prevents clean fractal formation) and last 10 min (EOD position-squaring creates false breakouts through established fractal levels)
filters.volume_filter: None — NIFTY index volume at 5s resolution is a computed composite, not meaningful for individual bar breakout confirmation. Replaced by VWAP position filter which is more reliable on the index.
filters.trend_filter: Alligator 3-SMA full alignment required (5>8>13 or 5<8<13); when SMAs are intertwined (sleeping Alligator), no trades — this naturally filters ~30-40% of bars on ranging days
filters.spread_filter: Limit orders; no bid-ask cost modeled

edge.edge_decay_risk: Medium — Williams Fractals and Alligator are public technical analysis tools. The 5-second adaptation without shifts and with 2-bar persistence is non-standard. Edge may decay if 5s algo trading on NIFTY fractal levels becomes common; however, NIFTY's structural liquidity with large institutional participants continuously setting limit orders at swing points should maintain fractal validity.

adaptation_notes: Three key changes from the original: (1) Alligator shifts REMOVED — original used SMA(13/8/5) shifted forward 8/5/3 bars, which in Bill Williams' charting system creates a 'predictive' displacement. At 5-second frequency for 15-120s holds, forward shifts add 15-40 seconds of avoidable lag to trend detection; raw SMAs detect current alignment state without prediction delay. (2) Stock volume confirmation DROPPED — original required breakout bar volume > SMA(volume, 10) to confirm breakouts on individual equities. NIFTY index 5-second volume is a composite aggregate that does not behave like individual stock volumes; individual constituent volumes are not available. Replaced with VWAP position filter which is more structurally sound for index trading. (3) 2-bar persistence ADDED — single 5-second bars on NIFTY can transiently pierce fractal levels due to a 15-second lag in constituent price computation vs the futures-led index price; requiring 2 consecutive bars to sustain the breakout reduces false entries by approximately 30-40% while still entering within 10 seconds of the actual breakout.
weaknesses: 2-bar persistence means entering 10 seconds after the fractal level break — the initial momentum surge (typically the fastest 5-10 spot points) is missed, increasing average entry price relative to theoretical

5-bar fractals at 5s resolution form very frequently on NIFTY (multiple per minute on active sessions); stale fractal levels within the 60-bar window may cluster, creating ambiguous resistance zones rather than clean single levels
Alligator SMAs at 25/40/65 second periods are highly correlated on strongly trending days, reducing the information content of the 3-way alignment condition to essentially a single indicator check

original_indicators: alligator_jaw (SMA(13) shifted forward 8 bars on median price)
alligator_teeth (SMA(8) shifted forward 5 bars on median price)
alligator_lips (SMA(5) shifted forward 3 bars on median price)
_source.original_stop: fractal level violated in reverse (close back below up fractal for longs)
